Mrs. Fisher: Here comes the lucky boy.
You: Lucky boy? What do you mean?
Mrs. Fisher: You caught a huge golden salmon. If you weren’t lucky before, for sure you are lucky now.
You: Are these fishes really that rare?
Mrs. Fisher: Golden salmon aren't a species. It’s a rare genetic mutation that causes a normal salmon to change color.
Mrs. Fisher: They are also considered lucky fish. It said that these fish bring wealth and prosperity to anyone that catches them.
Mrs. Fisher: Try buying a lottery ticket, kid. You won’t ever have bigger chances of winning than now.
You: Sorry, the lottery isn’t my thing-
You: Ugh!{{punch}}
I couldn’t finish my sentence, because Mrs. Fisher brought my face towards her bosom and started rubbing it deep, against her breasts! 
You: W-What was that about! 
Mrs. Fisher: Don’t mind me, I was just trying to rub off some of that luck for me, since you don’t need it. You see, it so happens that the lottery is MY thing.
You: Sure, but please give me a warning next time…
